elements.text: Pilots' decision to land without performing a required landing distance assessment due to contaminated runway and deteriorating weather
Fatigue produced by a long, demanding duty day
Captain's duties associated with check airman functions contributing to fatigue/poor decision-making
FAA pilot flight and duty time regulations permitting the long, demanding duty day
TVC operations supervisor's use of ambiguous and unspecific radio phraseology in providing runway braking information
Recommendation to emphasize timely postaccident drug and alcohol testing
Recommendation to address initial training on landing distance assessments
Recommendation to issue CertAlert regarding specific radio communications
Recommendation to require absolute criteria for runway closure in snow and ice control plans
Reiteration of recommendation to evaluate and implement crash detection technologies
